newsitem.title: USA: GeoScience Q3 shr expected to shrink.
newsitem.headline: GeoScience Q3 shr expected to shrink.

text.p: GeoScience Corp said Tuesday it expects to report third quarter earnings of between $0.09 and $0.12 per share, a decrease from the $0.22 per share posted in the same period the previous year.
The company said the lower-than-expected earnings are primarily the result of continued slower sales of its software.

GeoScience said that as a result, operating expenses at its CogniSeis software unit are "currently out of line with revenues." It has moved to cut costs at CogniSeis, including consolidating locations and cutting staff, it said.
Net income for the quarter ended September 30 is expected to be between $1 million and $1.3 million. In the same period the year before, the company reported net income of $1.7 million.

The company said the CogniSeis unit incurred restructuring costs of about $514,000 during the quarter to consolidate its software development staff from Calgary, Canada, to its development center in Boulder, Colo.
The expense was partially offset by a research and development credit refund of about $343,000 from the Canadian tax authority, it said.
GeoScience did not say how many staff positions were eliminated or the extent of the cost cuts.
The company designs, develops and manufactures seismic data systems, geoscientific software and related products for the oil and gas industry.
